Name: Literature review and research gap
Main tasks: Systematic search (IEEE, Springer, ScienceDirect, CVF, arXiv, SPIE); read the 5 closest papers in full; set up monthly alerts.
Expected output: Literature spreadsheet (updated), 2-page gap statement, final RQs
Completion criteria: Supervisor agrees the gap statement and RQs

Name: Dataset acquisition and audit
Main tasks: Download Carinthia-S, MVTec AD, Wafer Surface Defect, WM-811K; verify counts, classes, masks, licences; build split manifests.
Expected output: Dataset audit report; versioned manifests with hashes
Completion criteria: Every dataset has verified counts, licence and leak-free splits

Name: Baseline implementation
Main tasks: Implement PatchCore-style memory with WRN-50 and DINOv2 encoders; reproduce published MVTec AD numbers within tolerance.
Completion criteria: Reproduced AUROC within ~1 point of published values for several categories

Name: Reference-based few-shot anomaly detection
Main tasks: Few-shot enrolment (K = 1, 2, 5, 10); threshold calibration; Experiment A on MVTec AD, Carinthia-S, Wafer Surface Defect.
Completion criteria: Experiment A complete with 5 draws per K

Name: Rotation and geometric robustness
Main tasks: Implement coarse + fine registration, 'warp the reference', rotation-augmented memory; synthetic defect injection; DPR metric; Experiment B.
Completion criteria: Experiment B complete; DPR reported for all pipelines

Name: Defect localisation
Main tasks: Multi-scale anomaly maps; size-binned evaluation; Experiment F.
Completion criteria: Pixel AUROC / AUPRO / Dice reported by size bin

Name: Unknown anomaly detection
Main tasks: Known-defect memory; three-way triage; leave-one-class-out on Carinthia-S; Experiment E.
Completion criteria: Every class held out once; per-class results

Name: Feedback adaptation
Main tasks: Simulated feedback stream with controlled error rate; gated updates, quarantine, rollback; Experiment G.
Completion criteria: Held-out gains and forgetting reported with significance tests

Name: Experimental comparison and ablations
Main tasks: Full comparison against baselines; Experiments C, D, H; optional wafer-context study (RQ7).
Completion criteria: All planned experiments run or documented as infeasible

Name: Research paper writing
Main tasks: Write paper / thesis; release code and synthetic benchmark; reproducibility checklist.
